products.name: Onyx
products.category: AI coworker for Windows (as published on cyryxlabs.com: src/data/products.ts:27; product site tagline 'AI coworker for Windows')
products.audience: Individual owner on one Windows PC (src/data/onyx.ts FAQ 'Onyx works for one owner on one PC'); not a team product.
products.core_job: Desktop AI assistant that talks by voice, triages inbox and calendar, researches, operates apps and keeps a local note vault, asking before acting outside the machine (as stated, not tested).

evidence.observed: Headline 'Hire the employee who never logs off.'; 'Free while in beta'; version 1.14.45 shown in footer and beta section; 'Paid plans come later; the beta stays free while it runs.'; '(c) 2026 Cyryx Labs LLC' / 'Made by Cyryx Labs LLC.'; download buttons ('Download beta', 'Download the free beta', 'Download for Windows') point to https://onyx.cyryxlabs.com/download/Onyx-Windows-x64-Setup.exe; a modal asks name, work email, optional company and role with an opt-in for beta update e-mails and says the download starts right away; installer is not code-signed (SmartScreen warning, 'More info' > 'Run anyway'); privacy link to https://www.cyryxlabs.com/privacy; feedback via mailto contact@cyryxlabs.com; cites a BLS median pay figure for executive assistants.

Eyebrow 'Onyx - AI coworker for Windows - Free beta'; note 'Free while in beta. For Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit. Runs on free AI model tiers with your own keys. Version 1.14.25.'; CTAs link to https://onyx.cyryxlabs.com/ (not to the installer).

verification_gaps: Installer URL was observed on the page but the file was not downloaded, so it is not verified that it serves a working installer.
Whether the download modal is required or optional is unclear (page metadata flag 'meta-onyx-beta-form' reads 'off').
No capability (voice, inbox, approvals, tamper-evident log, spending caps) was tested.

dependencies_requirements.hardware: Dedicated GPU recommended for characters; lighter mode on older PCs (product site)

dependencies_requirements.companions: Android app pairing and Telegram (stated, not verified)

products.pricing_state: Free during beta; no paid price published; 'paid plans come later' with no date. Consistent with founder rule 'no prices published'.
limitations: Beta software; unsigned installer (not mentioned on cyryxlabs.com)
Requires user's own AI provider keys; free-tier data-use caveat
Website version string is stale (1.14.25 on cyryxlabs.com vs 1.14.45 on product site)
products.support_url: mailto:contact@cyryxlabs.com (subject 'Onyx beta feedback' on product site). No dedicated support page, terms of use or beta licence link observed.
